messages.author: c9416b6005bf4eb7
messages.subject: Fwd: useR! 2014 Tutorial Notification
parts:
Bad news: our tutorial for useR got rejected!

Oh well, maybe next year...

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Joshua Wiley <jwiley...@gmail.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 24, 2014 at 2:49 PM
Subject: useR! 2014 Tutorial Notification
To: Toby Hocking <tdh...@gmail.com>


Dear Toby Hocking,

 

I regret to inform you that your tutorial proposal titled “Interactive Graphics” to useR! 2014 was not accepted.  We had many excellent tutorial proposals this year, and due to space, were only able to accept approximately half.

 

If you are still interested in presenting, many of the tutorials may make good research talks and abstract submissions are open now.

 

Sincerely yours,

 

Joshua Wiley, on behalf of the local organizing committee


--
Joshua Wiley
